abstract: Records an Android app screen over ADB and cuts it to a narrated voiceover so that every sentence is shown while it is spoken. Aligns the script against a Whisper transcript of the shipped audio for millisecond-accurate sentence spans, anchors each recorded gesture to the sentence that promises it, paces by trimming still stretches rather than inserting freeze-frames, and enforces the result with three gates: a narration/visual contract, a beat-seam check, and an intrusion check on the raw clips. Produces a 1920x1200 mp4 with intro/agenda/outro cards, a drawn-on touch pointer, element highlights, burned-in subtitles, a transcript and an SRT. Carries eleven documented ADB/screenrecord traps, each of which shipped a broken video before it was understood.
